catalog.title: Catalog

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Search by name or phone, then open a full purchase and service history.

customers.duplicatesIntro: Records that share the same last 9 phone digits. Keep one and merge the other.
customers.noDuplicatesBody: Every phone number currently maps to a single customer.

kanban.title: Start on the board

new-request.title: Create a request
new-request.body: New request walks through the customer, product, warranty, and technician assignment.

notifications.body: Notifications collect overdue jobs, low stock, and assignment notes. The bell in the header is the same inbox.

management.title: Management tools
management.body: Inventory, technician schedule, audit log, duplicate customers, and backup settings stay in this lower section so the daily list stays short.

settings.title: Backup settings
settings.intro: Daily database dumps are configured on the server. This page only explains how they work — nothing here changes live data.
settings.backupBody: When BACKUP_ENABLED is true, the API writes a daily pg_dump into BACKUP_DIR.
settings.backupEnv: Set BACKUP_ENABLED, BACKUP_DIR, and BACKUP_RETAIN_DAYS in server/.env.
settings.backupManual: Run npm run db:backup from the repo root to take a dump by hand.
settings.backupRetain: Dumps older than BACKUP_RETAIN_DAYS (default 30) are removed after a successful run.
settings.restoreBody: Stop the API, restore the .sql file with psql into DATABASE_URL, then start the API again. Do not run db:reset after a restore.
settings.stockBody: The block-zero-stock toggle lives with spare parts in Inventory.
settings.staffBody: Staff, roles, passwords and pay rates.
settings.rulesBody: Deadlines and estimate rules apply system-wide.
settings.legalDaysHint: Past this limit the job is flagged as legally overdue.
settings.repairWarrantyDaysHint: If the same fault returns in this period, the repair is free.
settings.estimateDaysHint: The estimate expires after this period if the customer does not respond.
settings.storageDaysHint: How long a finished item is kept at the counter.
settings.requireEstimate: Require an approved estimate before paid repair
settings.requireEstimateTip: When on, the technician cannot start a paid repair until the customer approves the estimate.
